component.name: BurstSink
component.script:
' Same shape as the rooibos code-coverage collector: port-observes a hot field from init(). sub init() m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeFieldScoped("entry", m.port) m.top.observeFieldScoped("save", m.port) m.top.functionName = "runTask" m.top.control = "RUN" end sub
sub runTask() received = 0 while true msg = wait(0, m.port) if msg.getField() = "save" then m.top.received = received return end if received++ end while end sub
